description: Speech-to-text transcripts, one row per transcribed interaction. Typed, normalized and checked from workspace.bronze.call_transcripts. Event time comes from the parent interaction (issue 19). The text is templated, Spanish only and label-leaking (main_topics copies the contact reason, issue 16): use it for demos and lineage, never to train or evaluate intent models.

load.notes: Daily files partitioned by process_date. event_ts is looked up in workspace.bronze.call_center_interactions (Bronze, not Silver) so the table builds on its own.

transcript_id.description: Transcript identifier (TRS- + 20 alphanumerics), trimmed and upper-cased. Primary key.

interaction_id.description: Transcribed interaction (call_center_interactions.interaction_id). Natural key: one transcript per interaction.

event_ts.description: Start time of the parent interaction (its interaction_date). NULL, and the row quarantined, when the interaction is missing.

event_date.description: Calendar date of event_ts. Use this, not process_date, for daily aggregates and temporal splits.

process_date.description: Business-day cut-off inherited from the interaction (previous day before 08:00). Partition/pruning key only.

customer_id.description: Customer on the call; equals the interaction's customer_id in 171,321 / 171,321 rows.

agent_id.description: Agent on the call; equals the interaction's agent_id in 171,321 / 171,321 rows.

full_text.description: Full transcript (customer and agent turns). Templated: 546 distinct texts in 171,321 rows.

customer_text.description: Customer turns only. 42 distinct texts, independent of the contact reason.

agent_text.description: Agent turns only. Every row keeps unfilled template placeholders (see has_template_placeholders).

has_template_placeholders.description: FLAG: the text keeps unfilled template placeholders such as {monto}, {moneda} or {limite} (171,321 / 171,321 rows). Never show these texts to a customer as-is.

detected_language.description: Detected language, lower-cased ISO 639-1. 'es' in 171,321 / 171,321 rows: the dataset has no Portuguese, so PT evaluation data is team-generated and reported separately.

detected_accent.description: Accent detected in the audio, lower-cased; NULL for 36.8% of rows.

accent_confidence.description: Confidence of detected_accent in [0, 1] (observed 0.75-0.99). Present without an accent in 56,776 rows (missingness is independent; check accent_confidence_with_accent).

detected_keywords.description: Keywords split from the comma-separated source, lower-cased. Only 'servicio', 'cuenta' and 'banco' occur: no signal.

mentioned_entities.description: JSON object as delivered: counts of account_numbers, dates and amounts (0-2) and a products name or null. Holds counts, not values.

detected_intents.description: Intents split from the source, lower-cased. Only 'consulta_general' occurs (95.1%; NULL otherwise). Never a label.

main_topics.description: Topic label; an exact copy of the interaction's reason_category (171,321 / 171,321). Label leakage: exclude from every feature set.

transcription_model.description: Speech-to-text engine that produced the transcript (four engines, about 25% each).

audio_quality.description: Audio quality grade; NULL for 5.0% of rows.

duration_seconds.description: Call duration in seconds; equals the interaction's duration_seconds in 171,321 / 171,321 rows (NULL for chat and email).

checks.name: transcript_id_format
checks.description: Identifier follows the TRS- + 20 alphanumerics pattern.

checks.name: interaction_id_format
checks.description: Interaction identifier follows the INT- + 16 alphanumerics pattern.

checks.name: process_date_is_cutoff
checks.expr: process_date IS NULL OR event_date IS NULL OR process_date BETWEEN date_sub(event_date, 1) AND event_date
checks.description: process_date is the interaction's date or the previous business day, never later.

checks.name: detected_language_supported
checks.description: Transcript language is one the service supports (Spanish or Portuguese). Missing languages fail too.

checks.name: mentioned_entities_is_json
checks.expr: mentioned_entities IS NULL OR get_json_object(mentioned_entities, '$.account_numbers') IS NOT NULL
checks.description: mentioned_entities parses as the expected JSON object.

checks.name: accent_confidence_with_accent
checks.expr: accent_confidence IS NULL OR detected_accent IS NOT NULL
checks.description: A confidence is only reported for a detected accent.
